invariant: A witness is independently rooted relative to other witnesses only if its full recursively reachable source-root set is disjoint from theirs, using verified identity of origins.
rules: Detect shared source root across different direct parents
Handle multi-parent merges and overlapping ancestry
Reject cycles and unknown graph ancestry
Do not promote mere distinct-root count as proof of independence
limitations: The graph uses declared nodes; no external validation of source identities
Root-set disjointness is a necessary condition for declared independence, not sufficient proof of genuine source independence
Sequential witness order is used for overlap explanation, but allIndependent is order-independent
